messages:
Nina (Finance): Heads-up: new purchasing guidelines go live next Monday. Quick summary: updated PO numbering (see example below), a stricter vendor-creation flow, and an "emergency procurement" channel for same-week needs. Please skim the doc and flag questions.

Ravi (Eng): Thanks. Does this change how we handle infra credits/marketplace billing?

Nina (Finance): Short answer: marketplace/invoice credits keep current flow but must reference the new PO in the invoice metadata. Procurement will help map legacy credits during the transition week.

Sam (Product): What counts as "emergency procurement"?

Lina (Procurement): Emergency is limited to buys that, if delayed, block customer SLAs or a production rollback. It requires manager + procurement lead signoff and Finance buys the vendor onboarding fast track. Abuse will be flagged.

Nina (Finance): New PO format (example):

```
PO-2026-ENG-0427-000123
^year-deptcode-month-uniqueid
```

Nina (Finance): Please use the dept codes in the chart on the intranet when you submit a PO request. This helps cost-center tagging and monthly reporting.

finance-bot: Reminder: all PO requests must include a cost center tag and estimated monthly ARR impact if applicable. Docs: https://intranet.redwood/finance/purchase-guidelines :link:

Ravi (Eng): For subscriptions that auto-renew, should we still make a PO every renewal cycle?

Lina (Procurement): If it's an annual contract, create a single PO for the term and note renewal terms in the contract field. For month-to-month SaaS where spend < $3k/month, you can use delegated approval, but still attach the cost center.

Sam (Product): Are there changes to who can create vendors in the system? Last time we had duplicates.

Lina (Procurement): Yes: vendor creation is now limited to Procurement and a named delegate list. If you need a new vendor, submit the vendor intake form — include W-9 or equivalent — Procurement will do the duplicate-check and do the onboarding. Expect 3-5 business days.

Nina (Finance): Extra: for any vendor where data sensitivity is a factor, include the security contact in the form. Legal will triage.

Ravi (Eng): If procurement turnaround is 3-5 days, is there a temporary workaround for conferences or event rentals?

Nina (Finance): Use the temporary vendor path: submit the intake with "temp" flag + manager approval; Procurement will fast-track if requested at least 48 hours before the event. For same-day needs use emergency procurement (see above).

Sam (Product): Can Procurement publish a checklist we can pin in channels? That would help new PMs.

Lina (Procurement): Will do. I'll post a one-page checklist and the new dept-code table by Friday.

Nina (Finance): Last note: we'll run a cleanup of old draft POs next week. Any drafts older than 90 days will be archived; owners will get a notification. Reach out if you need an exception.

finance-bot: Action required: review the new purchase guidelines before Monday. You will receive a short quiz to confirm you've read it. :white_check_mark:
